results.content:
## 1. HappyScribe

Best for: Secure and accurate AI meeting notes, global language coverage, file transcription, and clean UI

 

While Read AI tries to be your digital work assistant, HappyScribe AI note taker takes a different approach. It focuses strictly on giving you highly accurate meeting transcripts and keeping your data entirely under your control.

If you manage international teams or handle sensitive client calls, you need a tool that works for you, instead of annoying other meeting attendees.

### HappyScribe vs. Read AI [...] For Microsoft Teams and Google Meet, top Read AI alternatives include HappyScribe, Fireflies, and Fellow. HappyScribe is excellent for capturing accurate transcripts with precise speaker identification without bothering attendees. Fireflies is ideal for sales calls because its conversation intelligence features push data directly into CRMs. Meanwhile, Fellow improves meeting efficiency by letting you use custom meeting templates, generate meeting reports, and sync tasks into project management tools. All these options offer flexible paid plans to unlock premium AI features.

Biplab Mazumder

Written by 

#### Biplab Mazumder [...] ## Which Read AI alternative is right for you?

Deciding on the right AI meeting assistant comes down to what slows down your work the most. If all your meetings live inside Zoom, Meet, and Teams, and you’re happy with serviceable transcripts, Fathom provides a generous free tier. Revenue teams that need to inspect pipeline health should look at Chorus by ZoomInfo or Fireflies, depending on budgets. If you work in a regulated industry, Fellow enforces the strict domain controls.

Having said that, your main issue with Read AI might just be the invasive bot and the lack of transcript accuracy. You likely want to capture meeting notes without forcing external guests to create accounts.

results.title: 8 Budget-Friendly AI Meeting Assistant Tools for Startups
results.content:
8. Granola.ai

Granola.ai takes a different approach to AI meeting notes: instead of a bot joining your call, it transcribes your computer's audio directly, with no meeting bot joining your call. You jot rough notes during the meeting, and Granola enhances them into a clean, structured summary when the call ends. [...] What it does well: MeetGeek supports multiple platforms (Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams), produces AI meeting notes and automatic meeting summaries, and includes basic conversation analytics like talk ratios. It has iOS and Android apps, which not every tool in this category supports. Meeting templates help structure recurring meetings more consistently.

Where it falls short: The analytics aren't as sophisticated as tools built for sales coaching or product research. Meeting transcriptions are solid, but the AI features in the free plan are limited.

Pricing: Free plan available. Paid plans start at $9.99/month.

7. Notta.ai

Notta.ai is a straightforward AI note-taker that earns its place on this list primarily through its affordable pricing and solid multilingual support. [...] What it does well: Notta transcribes in 58 languages and produces clean AI meeting notes with summaries and action items. It works across Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams, exports to Google Docs easily, and has a decent free tier for light usage.

Where it falls short: Notta is a capable transcription tool, not a meeting intelligence platform. You get accurate AI meeting notes — you don't get cross-channel search, CRM integration, or anything that connects your meetings to the broader context of what your team is working on.

Pricing: Free plan with limited minutes. Paid plans start at $8.17/month.
